summary: Make the local Remotion/Jianying preview voice-first and eliminate scene/subtitle drift.
constraints: Use the pinned local jianying-editor-skill for SAMI voice and native subtitles.
Use Remotion as the only execution renderer; HyperFrames rules are clean-room timing/layout guidance only.
Do not call HeyGen or any other remote provider in Phase 1.
Keep one subtitle authority: Jianying native subtitles; Remotion visual remains subtitle-free.
All generated outputs and reports stay on E:, and old artifacts remain untouched.
Fail closed if measured voice timing and final draft timing diverge beyond one video frame.
acceptance: A versioned timing manifest records every narration start/end and the source audio hash.
Remotion scene boundaries equal the timing manifest boundaries within one 30 FPS frame.
Jianying VoiceOver and native subtitle segments use the same starts and measured durations.
The assembled preview contains audible AAC and full-decodes successfully.
Targeted and existing video regressions pass; formal Phase 1 remains not passed.
